name: LianChuang Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: LianChuang Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of optics and optoelectronics in China and internationally. The company offers optical parts, comprising plastic structural parts, plastic lens, aspherical molded glass lens, spherical glass lens, and optical precision molds; HD wide angle lens and modules; and automotive products.
